description: Original official Soybean_901/902/903/905 parameters with pinned public NASA POWER daily weather for four representative regional locations. No cultivar fitting, renaming, yield scaling, or imposed weather perturbation.

crop_source.license: EUPL as declared by the upstream YAML
crop_source.identity_policy: Keep exact official variety IDs; regional parameter identities are not commercial cultivar names.

weather_provider: NASA POWER daily point API; AG community
weather_evidence_type: Public gridded meteorological product, not field-station observations from the original crop calibration trial.

weather_normalization.mean_temperature: If required, derive (tmin_c + tmax_c) / 2; this is a declared model input derivation, not an independently measured mean.

soil_and_initial_nitrogen.status: Defined separately and explicitly by the formal model-reference world; no measured trial soil or initial nitrogen is claimed here.

acceptance_scope: Native WOFOST parity under identical crop, weather, soil, site, calendar and management inputs.
Full-season tool workflow execution in the formal world.
excluded_claims: Reproduction of the original 1993 field trials.
A measured yield observation for these exact 2019 location-management combinations.
Validation that model predictions equal real farm yields.

rows.sowing_date_basis: Official variety metadata month/day; 2019 is a model-reference year, not the original calibration trial.
